source_clause: PVAL4) If during the initiation of Valet Mode, and/or activation/deactivation of the Valet PIN the user presses another portion of the screen, treat as a cancel command.
leaf_desc_037: PVAL4) If during the initiation of Valet Mode, and/or activation/deactivation of the Valet PIN the user presses another portion of the screen, treat as a cancel command.
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.4（PVAL4）—— PIN 輸入期間按畫面他處視為取消。關鍵情境條件：條文涵蓋啟用與停用兩側之 PIN，本條取啟用側；停用側之取消行為相同，未另切 TC（037 未為其切 leaf）。為什麼這樣切：ER3 併驗「未進入 Valet Mode」—— 只驗畫面關閉，一個關掉畫面卻已啟用之實作會通過（§7）。

tcs.tc_title: Pressing elsewhere cancels the Valet PIN entry
tcs.test_item:
Pressing elsewhere cancels the Valet PIN entry
(Verifies that pressing elsewhere on the screen during PIN entry cancels the entry)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Valet Mode is not active
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start the Valet Mode activation so that the PIN entry is displayed
2. Press another portion of the screen outside the PIN entry
3. Read the screen and check that the PIN entry is cancelled
tcs.expected_result:
1. The PIN entry is displayed
2. The press outside the PIN entry is treated as a cancel command
3. The PIN entry is closed and Valet Mode is not active
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
